providers.plain_description: Fit fold-local features and models, then combine out-of-fold predictions.
providers.validity_bounds: Validated PreparedComplete from the qualified prepare stage. Training-only median/clipping/screening, one-hot/count/frequency and group-excluded target means; explicit interactions, signed log copies, aggregates, LDA text topics, supervised categorical embeddings and optional RFE. Each outer fold independently fits features and logistic/ExtraTrees models. Logistic stacker uses exactly one OOF score pair per row; final base models refit all training rows. Group identity and feature applicability remain caller policy. Serial native pools and n_jobs=1; dense large-table resource use unqualified.
